headline: Congress named a Norco, California Postal Service building after Lance Corporal Kareem Nikoui.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 1801 Town and Country Drive in Norco, California, as the Lance Corporal Kareem Nikoui Memorial Post Office Building. It is a naming law only and does not change how the post office operates. The official summary does not describe any other changes.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on October 11, 2022.
